[305] CONSTRAINTS
springdoc OpenAPI generation limits (affect generated docs only, not runtime behavior): (1) every operation is emitted as 200 regardless of the controller's actual `ResponseEntity`/`@ResponseStatus` (real codes include 201/202/204); (2) it cannot derive a request-body schema from endpoints that hand-parse multipart via raw `MultipartHttpServletRequest`/`HttpServletRequest` — affects M1-A01, M3-A01, M3-A02; (3) response `data` is derived only from the method return type, so `SuccessEnvelope.data(Object)` renders as a generic object on every endpoint.
